title: Workflow status as JSON
problem: CLI automation needs a stable shape for run status.
outcome: The user gets the state and the waiting reason without parsing TUI text.
inScope: Reading a snapshot by run ID
outOfScope: Starting agents from the status command

requirements.text: status returns runId, status, reason and revision of an existing run
status does not call a model and does not change the run

criteria.then: stdout contains one JSON snapshot with the waiting reason

criteria.given: The run ID does not exist
criteria.then: NOT_FOUND and exit code 1 are returned
The revision does not change and AgentExecutor is not called
